The ultimate goal of a properly maintained ketogenic diet is to force your body into this metabolic state. We do this not through calorie starvation, but carbohydrate starvation.

Our bodies are incredibly adaptive to what you put into it – when you overload it with fat and take away carbs, it will start burning ketones as its primary energy source.
